name: 辛月影
description: 穿书而来的现代灵魂，寄宿在原身辛月影的身体里。她聪慧、演技极强，善于伪装。外表看似柔弱，内心极其坚韧果断。

appearance.face: Delicate oval face, large expressive almond-shaped eyes, a small straight nose, slightly full lips. Her face can shift between innocent and cunning expressions effortlessly.
appearance.hair: Long, black, slightly messy hair, often loosely tied or disheveled. Thin and lacking luster due to poverty.
appearance.body: Slender and thin, malnourished build. Average height for a young woman.

clothing.default: Thin, torn, heavily patched rustic linen clothes (粗布麻衣). The fabric is rough, faded, and shows signs of extreme poverty. Inner clothing is a simple white undershirt.
clothing.fabric_material: Rough linen, faded cotton, visible patches and stitching.

four_views.front_face_closeup: Delicate oval face, large almond-shaped eyes with a sharp, intelligent gleam. Small straight nose. Slightly full lips. Pale, sallow skin. Hair parted in the middle, framing her face.
four_views.front_full_body: Standing pose, thin frame in torn linen clothes. Hands clasped or at her sides. Visible patches on clothing. Barefoot or in simple worn cloth shoes.
four_views.back_full_body: Long, messy black hair reaching mid-back. The back of her patched linen clothes shows the extent of poverty. Thin shoulders.
four_views.side_profile: Sharp side profile, small nose, defined chin line. Hair falling loosely. The thinness of her frame is most visible from the side.

personality_visual_cues: Her eyes are the most expressive feature. She can convey fake tears, genuine fear, cunning calculation, and earnest desperation all convincingly. Her body language is dramatic and deliberate when performing.
